hikes.name: Tom McCall Point
hikes.blurb: Spring wildflower slopes to a grassy summit over the river's big bend at Rowena, Mt Hood behind.

hikes.name: Mosier Plateau
hikes.blurb: Past a hidden falls and a pioneer cemetery to an open bluff over the town of Mosier.

hikes.name: Coyote Wall and the Labyrinth
hikes.blurb: Up the edge of a long, tilted basalt cliff with balsamroot fields and big river views.

hikes.name: Mitchell Point
hikes.blurb: A short, steep climb to a narrow rock spine standing high over the river and the highway.

hikes.name: Mount Defiance via Starvation Creek
hikes.blurb: The Gorge's biggest climb, almost 5,000 feet past waterfalls to its highest point.

hikes.name: Starvation Creek Falls
hikes.blurb: A two-minute walk from the rest area to a 186-foot falls.

hikes.name: Lyle Cherry Orchard
hikes.blurb: Up open oak slopes above Lyle to an old orchard with a huge view of the eastern Gorge.

hikes.name: Horsethief Butte
hikes.blurb: A short walk into a basalt fortress with rock-climbing walls and a view over the river.

hikes.name: Lower Deschutes River Trail
start: Historic Oregon Trail Deschutes River Crossing
hikes.blurb: Along the lower Deschutes canyon on an old rail grade between dry basalt walls.

hikes.name: Wygant Peak
hikes.blurb: From Mitchell Point Trailhead, a 7.9-mile round trip to the top of Wygant Peak (2,208 ft), with about 2,750 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: File Butte
hikes.blurb: From Vista Ridge Trailhead, an 11.2-mile round trip to the top of File Butte (4,920 ft), with about 2,300 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Bald Butte
hikes.blurb: From Oak Ridge Trailhead, a 6.4-mile round trip to the top of Bald Butte (3,763 ft), with about 2,150 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Wygant Middle Viewpoint
hikes.blurb: From Mitchell Point Trailhead, a 5.5-mile round trip to Wygant Middle Viewpoint, with about 1,700 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Surveyor's Ridge
hikes.blurb: From Oak Ridge Trailhead, a 4.9-mile round trip to the Surveyor's Ridge viewpoint, with about 1,650 feet of climbing.
